title: Account Impact Concierge & Prioritization Slate
creator: Ariana Patel
description:
Summary:
Create an "Account Impact Concierge" process and an associated "Prioritization Slate" that consistently scores and surfaces top-account roadmap asks and escalations. The goal is to reduce subjective triage, make commit decisions measurable, and provide a lightweight simulation for commit runway and opportunity cost.

Why now:
- Multiple enterprise customers are asking for SLAs and feature commitments tied to renewals; engineering capacity is constrained.
- PMs and Sales currently use ad-hoc signals (email, slack pings, exec escalations) causing inconsistent commitments and unscoped work.
- Executive ask: reduce time-to-decision for escalations to <= 10 business days and create an auditable decision record.

Scope (in-scope):
- Define a compact scoring rubric (5 signals) and implement a scoring sheet for Sales/Customer Success to submit requests.
- Build a lightweight concierge workflow in Console to intake and route requests (no heavy UI to start; use a modal + ticket backend).
- Provide a Prioritization Slate view for PMs/Eng leads showing normalized scores, estimated effort, and simulated commit runway.
- Pilot with 5 prioritized accounts for Q1/Q2 decisions.

Out of scope:
- Full automation of implementation estimates (we will use fast-scan engineer estimates initially).
- Enterprise legal contracting or changes to pricing models (handled by GTM).

Scoring rubric (proposed):
Normalized score 0-100 composed of weighted components:
- Business Value (40%) — expected ARR/expansion lift, strategic upsell potential.
- Renewal Urgency (25%) — time to renewal and relative revenue at risk.
- Strategic Fit (20%) — alignment with product roadmap/OKRs and cross-customer applicability.
- Implementation Effort (15%) — inverse weighted (lower effort increases priority).
Example formula: Score = round(0.4*BV + 0.25*RU + 0.2*SF + 0.15*(100 - EffortEstimate)).

Decision gates and SLAs:
- Initial intake acknowledgement: 1 business day.
- Concierge assessment + score: 3 business days.
- PM sync + decision (Accept/Defer/Need more info): 7 business days from intake (10 bdays total to final decision).
- Accepted asks enter a timeboxed Commit Runway (estimated delivery window).

Deliverables:
- Scoring sheet template (Google Sheet + CSV export).
- Intake modal spec (Console) and minimal backend schema.
- Prioritization Slate UI spec (list + filters + simulated runways).
- Pilot playbook and 5-account rollout checklist.
- Post-pilot retrospective and KPI dashboard queries.

Success metrics (pilot):
- Time to final decision <= 10 business days (target).
- Acceptance rate of escalations (target 30-50%, measured).
- Revenue at-risk preserved (qualitative target: prevent 2 renewals slipping).
- Internal satisfaction (PM/Sales CS survey) >= 4/5.

Stakeholders:
- Product: Ariana Patel (Initiative lead), Marco Chen (PM owner)
- Sales/CS: Leah Ortiz (Account Advocate pilot lead)
- Eng: Reliability/Runtime leads for effort checks
- GTM/Legal: Advisory only during pilot

Data sources for scoring:
- CRM ARR/renewal dates (Salesforce link)
- Usage/latency signals (Console dashboards)
- Historical implementation effort from past tickets (Linear/GitHub metadata)

Risks and mitigations:
- Risk: Score gamification by Sales. Mitigation: require supporting evidence fields and periodic audit sampling.
- Risk: Engineering bandwidth mis-estimation. Mitigation: include an engineer quick-scan step and require both PM + Eng signoff before commit.

Rollout plan:
1) Week 0-2: Finalize scoring rubric and intake template; internal review.
2) Week 3-4: Build intake modal & backend; wireframe Prioritization Slate.
3) Week 5-8: Pilot with 5 accounts; weekly concierge syncs.
4) End of pilot: Retrospective + adjust rubric + plan for broader rollout.
acceptance_criteria: Intake modal implemented in Console with required fields and submit flow (acknowledgement + ticket created).
Scoring sheet template available and integrated to export CSV for batch import into slate view.
Prioritization Slate prototype shows list of requests, normalized score, effort estimate, and simulated commit runway.
Pilot run with 5 accounts completed and retrospective documented with recommendations.
KPI queries created: time-to-decision, acceptance rate, and revenue at-risk preserved.
Documentation: concierge playbook published in Confluence and shared with Sales/CS.
At least one cross-functional signoff (PM + Eng + Sales) required on any 'Accepted' item during pilot.
